dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped light-colored rings with feathered, high-contrast perimeters. Gradients transition from dark fur to light ring-paths and back to dark interiors. Prominent structures include a large central oval ring and a cluster of interconnected rings on the posterior-lateral side.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of small, high-intensity white punctate blobs, primarily clustered along the dorsal ridge and interspersed between larger ring structures; these clusters lack internal gradients and appear as solid pixel groups.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three most prominent macro-annuli (central, upper-mid, and right-lateral) form an elongated scalene triangle. Smaller blobs form a secondary linear cluster extending towards the anterior region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of a human-made electronic tracking device glued to the mid-lateral pelt, featuring a white cylindrical component and a green base with an antenna.
other_distinctive_markers: A thin, linear light-colored mark, possibly a hair or a surface scratch, extends diagonally across the mid-posterior texture pattern.
